page: Amazon Web Services c8a.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9R45 processor with 16 dedicated physical cores and 16 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 4.5 GHz. The CPU architecture includes 48 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core, alongside support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512, AVX_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16.

The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware. Network connectivity is provisioned at an 8 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the c8a.4xlarge demonstrates top-tier single-core performance, scoring in the top 10% for stress-ng single-core CPU tests, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded gzip and bzip3 operations. Multi-core performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations fall within the average range. It also shows strong performance in static web serving throughput and small-model LLM text generation.

Given its compute-heavy profile, high clock speed, and DDR5 memory, the c8a.4xlarge offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring intense single-threaded performance or vector calculations without massive memory footprints. It is well-suited for web serving, image processing, text processing, and lightweight machine learning inference.
